job_queue_view.title: Job Queue
job_queue_view.intro_note: Shows all running, waiting and finished background jobs (scan, rename, export, scan & repair etc.) with progress. Pause/Resume/Cancel act cooperatively - a job checks this status between individual work steps, so it doesn't stop instantly but at the next safe checkpoint.
job_queue_view.cancel_confirm_text: Really cancel job '{job_id}'? Already processed items stay as logged, nothing is rolled back.

error_center_view.title: Error Center
error_center_view.intro_note: All logged errors with a permanently lookup-able error ID (§37). 'Mark as resolved' is purely organisational and never changes any files or domain data.

diagnostics_view.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics_view.intro_note: A read-only health report covering the database, file system, configured providers and the plugin system. Changes nothing - repairs happen exclusively via 'Scan & Repair' (plan → preview → execute).

backups_view.title: Backups
backups_view.intro_note: Covers only the database and configuration - never media files. Creating is uncritical (an extra copy); restoring replaces the active database and therefore needs confirmation.
backups_view.restore_confirm_text: Really restore backup #{backup_id}? This replaces the currently active database. A safety copy of the current state is created automatically beforehand.

plugins_view.title: Plugins
plugins_view.intro_note: Shows all plugins loaded from the local plugin folder - including failed ones, with a plain-text error message. A broken plugin never prevents the others from loading and never crashes the application.

settings_view.title: Settings
settings_view.intro_note: This page replaces manually editing config.yaml (§55) – changes are applied to the running Core Service immediately (some path changes may require a restart, see the note after saving) and are also persisted permanently.
settings_view.save_confirm_text: The changed settings will take effect immediately. Continue?
settings_view.save_done_restart_required: Settings saved. Some path changes require a Core Service restart to take full effect.
settings_view.media_folders_note: This list is a pure UI convenience list – a scan can be started with any folders at any time, regardless of whether the list has been saved.
settings_view.scan_no_folders: No folders in the list – please add a folder first.
settings_view.loudness_overwrite_warning: Warning: if enabled, normalization can overwrite the original file directly instead of creating a copy (Principle #5) – leave disabled if unsure.

providers_view.title: Metadata providers
providers_view.intro_note: Manages the ONLINE metadata lookup (§10/§11): MusicBrainz, AcoustID and Cover Art Archive. Disabled by default (§56, no internet requirement) – even when enabled, every match remains only a suggestion with a confidence value, never an automatic adoption (Principle #17). For download providers (YouTube/TikTok/…) see the Download Center.
providers_view.metadata_enabled_note: GENESIS only connects to the services configured below when this is enabled.
providers_view.acoustid_api_key_note: AcoustID requires a personal, free API key (see acoustid.org/api-key) – GENESIS does not ship one of its own.
providers_view.contact_email_note: Required by the MusicBrainz API policy for a meaningful User-Agent header – without it, IP bans for all users are a risk.
providers_view.min_confidence_note: Matches below this confidence are not shown at all (less noise) – above it, it still always remains only a suggestion.
providers_view.save_confirm_text: The changed settings will take effect immediately. Continue?
